scenes.heading: Building a portfolio when you have no clients yet

sents.d: Building a portfolio when you have no clients yet
Spec pieces and personal writing can demonstrate skill just as well as paid work.

A lack of paid client work doesn't mean a lack of portfolio material — well-written spec pieces (a sample email sequence for a fictional or real brand, a rewritten version of an existing weak landing page) demonstrate the same skills as paid work.

Starting a personal blog or newsletter in the niche you want to write for serves two purposes: it's portfolio material, and it demonstrates consistency, which many potential clients care about as much as raw writing skill.
Guest posting for established blogs or publications in your target niche, even unpaid early on, can provide credible bylines and portfolio pieces faster than waiting for paid opportunities to appear.

take: Build samples yourself instead of waiting for clients.
